title: Whale Borong 40.100 BTC Senilai $2,6 Miliar, Bitcoin Masuk Bulan Terlemah
content:

title: Bitwise is liquidating six crypto option ETFs that offered 25% payouts while returning investors’ own capital
content:
Friday, July 31, was the final trading day for six Bitwise option-income ETFs. Shareholders still holding shares as of Aug. 3 face automatic cash redemption rather than an exchange sale.
The Bitwise Funds Trust board voted June 30 to liquidate ICOI, IMRA, IMST, IGME, ICRC, and IETH, according to an SEC prospectus supplement.

title: 亏损5.55亿美元，Trump Media向Crypto.com转入2628枚比特币
content: Odaily星球日报讯 据链上分析师余烬监测，Trump Media 在 6 小时前将 2628 枚比特币转入 Crypto.com 交易所。该公司目前在比特币上亏损高达 5.55 亿美元。去年 7 至 8 月，Trump Media 通过出售公司股票和可转换债券筹集资金后买入 11542 枚比特币，金额为 13.68 亿美元，均价 118529 美元。今年以来，该公司已陆续卖出 7281 枚比特币，金额为 5.45 亿美元，均价约 74860 美元，实现亏损 3.18 亿美元。其目前仍持有 4261 枚比特币，价值 2.68 亿美元，未实现亏损 2.37 亿美元。
